chars.SISTER: a Moroccan woman in her early 30s wearing a beige hijab and a long dark burgundy wool coat
chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan young man aged 29 with short black hair and a trimmed beard, wearing an olive green hoodie
chars.MOM: a Moroccan woman in her late 50s wearing a white headscarf and a light blue djellaba
chars.LITTLE: a Moroccan teenage girl with a black ponytail wearing a mustard yellow sweatshirt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, a modest Casablanca apartment entrance. SISTER stands in the open front doorway, crying hard, one hand pressed to her mouth, tears on her cheeks, seen head-to-waist from the dim hallway where her brother stands. Dark stairwell behind her, cold yellow stair light. Emotional, cinematic 2D illustration.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Evening in a cosy Moroccan living room in Casablanca: NARRATOR and MOM sit at a low round table eating dinner, a tagine and bread, MOM serves him, warm lamp light, relaxed ordinary family moment, TV glow in the background.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same cosy Moroccan living room at night: LITTLE sits on the sedari sofa doing school homework with notebooks open on her lap, pen in hand, concentrating, warm lamp light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room at night: NARRATOR and MOM freeze mid-dinner and turn their heads sharply toward the front door off-screen, startled worried faces, bread in hand, tense suspense lighting, the hallway door visible in the background.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night at the apartment front door: NARRATOR, shocked, holds the door open; SISTER stands on the landing crying, her eyes swollen and darkened bluish around them, tears, looking at him helplessly. Seen from the side so both faces are visible, cold stairwell light, dramatic but not graphic.
